slug: 2024-04-23 Tunisia - Biometric ID card and passport usage to begin in H1 2025

facts.fact: A ministerial session on 2024-04-22 decided to start using the biometric national identity card in H1 2025 following approval of Organic Law No. 22 of 2024 on the biometric identity card; the document gives no promulgation date and does not say the law is not yet in force.
facts.system: Organic Law No. 22 of 2024 on the biometric identity card

slug: 2024-04-23 Tunisia to Get Biometric IDs in H1 of 2025

facts.fact: ID Tech reports that adoption of biometric ID cards was made possible through approval of Organic Law No. 22 of 2024, which ranks above ordinary statutes, with rollout targeted for H1 2025; the document gives no promulgation date.
facts.system: Organic Law No. 22 of 2024 on the biometric identity card

facts.fact: Organic Law No. 2024-22 of 11 March 2024, published in JORT No. 37 of 12 March 2024, amends and completes Law No. 93-27 of 22 March 1993 on the national identity card, issued by the Ministry of Interior; an organic law promulgated by the President.
facts.system: Law No. 93-27 of 1993 on the national identity card, as amended by Organic Law No. 2024-22 of 2024

facts.fact: Organic Law No. 2024-22 of 2024 provides that the identity card carries an encrypted secure electronic chip holding the card number and fingerprint and photo, and an electronic certificate allowing identity verification and electronic signature; it leaves the card model to a decree and the certificate rules to a joint ministerial order, with no such instrument dated in the document.
facts.system: Law No. 93-27 of 1993 on the national identity card, as amended by Organic Law No. 2024-22 of 2024

slug: 2024-03-07 Eight years in the making - Tunisia's Biometric ID and Passport Bills risk rights

facts.fact: Access Now reports that the Ministry of Interior's fourth draft biometric ID law was approved by a ministerial council on 30 November 2023, sent to Parliament's Committee on Rights and Freedoms on 25 December 2023, and adopted by an overwhelming majority on 6 March 2024; the document does not mention promulgation.
